summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 2026 financial results, including a 498% revenue increase to $43.0 million, net income of $181.8 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $17.6 million. The filing also discloses the closing of an oversubscribed US$800 million convertible senior notes offering (2.25% due 2031), leaving cash at C$1.2 billion. Operational highlights include Sangdong mine commissioning, an offtake amendment with GTP extending term by six years and increasing volumes by 40%, and Russell index inclusion. This is a routine earnings and financing update, not a special situation. Watch for ramp-up progress and Phase II expansion updates.
